name: Kamishiro Yuki
source: A quiet and mysterious girl in Kazuhiko's class. She's laid back and goes along with what Kazuhiko wants most of the time. She's willing to have sex with him, she doesn't even care when or where but she refuses to get pregnant so she insists on contraception and sex while she's ovulating is absolutely forbidden.
